text:
ops-bot: ⚠️ Alert: Elevated 5xx + request timeouts on /api/v1/generate across us-west-2. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 1.6s, p99 ~ 4.2s. Error rate +3.8% in last 2m
meera (oncall): I'm on it. rolling up dashboards. any deploys in last 10m?
james: Deploy of model-router v3.4.2 at 3172499980 (canary->prod). Canary looked fine.
linh: seeing huge queue growth on gateway instances: conn_wait and http2 stream stalls. logs show 504s from routing service.
sebastian: @meera can we toggle routing feature-flag back to old path? that cutover was the only change in this rollout.
meera (oncall): Initiating emergency safe-mode: setting ff-routing-v3 -> off. Doing via console now.
ops-bot: ff-routing-v3 set to OFF by meera (oncall) at 3172500055.
emily: metrics still elevated but trending down slightly. p95 1.2s, p99 3.1s. Some customer errors still visible.
meera (oncall): start rollback of model-router to v3.4.1. @james can you kick the rollback?
james: rolling back to v3.4.1, starting now. command: ./deploy rollback model-router --to 3.4.1 --force
sre-bot: rollback job 987654 started at 3172500108, estimated 90s. watch logs: https://ci/internal/rollbacks/987654
linh: adding temporary circuit-break on gateway -> route to avoid connection pooling pressure, increasing keepalive.
sebastian: customer-facing: tickets from two large customers (acct-232, acct-889) reporting timeouts. pinging success to prepare comms.
meera (oncall): rollback finished at 3172500195. Confirming: p95 140ms, p99 260ms, 5xx back to baseline.
emily: I'm seeing error rate back to normal. no new customer alerts.
meera (oncall): good. marking incident as mitigated. preserving deploy artifacts and logs. start postmortem ping.
james: capturing timeline and canary data. will include kernel/conn stats and gateway logs.
sebastian: customer comms prepped: short note + apology + RCA to follow.
meera (oncall): handing to oncall-sre for postmortem and follow-up. tagging: @sre-team. next steps: analyze why canary passed but prod overwhelmed (routing traffic pattern difference?).
ops-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation=rollback, impact=partial errors/timeouts, severity=SEV2, resolved_at=3172500245
